description: Current Bambu Lab printer lineup as listed on bambulab.com, accessed 2026-11-12. Build volume is [width, depth, height] in mm for a single nozzle unless noted; temperatures in C. Each entry has a confirmed flag per field: true = read on a Bambu spec page or official spec PDF; false = search excerpt, forum, third party, or a Bambu overview page only. Flags updated from docs/specs/dfm-research/08-skipped-sources-addendum.md (spec pages and PDFs read 2026-11-12). The design defaults do not depend on a model; use this table for build volume, enclosure and nozzle questions. The R1 named on bambulab.com is a CO2 laser cutter, not a 3D printer, and is not listed.

a2l.name: A2L
a2l.multimaterial: AMS lite and second-generation AMS, up to 19 colors
a2l.note: Stainless nozzle. The reason for the 80 C bed (household power) is a search excerpt only (UNVERIFIED).

p1s.name: P1S
p1s.note: Stainless steel nozzle; carbon- and glass-fiber filled filaments not recommended. The /en/p1/tech-specs page returns 404; the official spec PDF was read instead.

p2s.name: P2S
p2s.chamber: enclosed, about 50 C by flap-controlled airflow and heat retention (no active heater stated)
p2s.note: The 50 C chamber figure is on the overview page (https://bambulab.com/en/p2s) only, not on the spec page.

x1c.name: X1 Carbon
x1c.note: Hardened steel nozzle. Bed 110 C at 220 V (the value kept) and 120 C at 110 V. Enclosed with no active chamber heater. The /en/x1/tech-specs page returns 404; the official spec PDF was read instead.

x2d.name: X2D
x2d.build.volume.note: main nozzle; auxiliary nozzle 235.5 x 256 x 256; both nozzles 235.5 x 256 x 256
x2d.multimaterial: two nozzles (main plus auxiliary for easy-remove supports); AMS

h2d.name: H2D
h2d.build.volume.note: single nozzle; both nozzles 300 x 320 x 320; total 350 x 320 x 320
h2d.multimaterial: two nozzles; AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT

h2d-pro.name: H2D Pro
h2d-pro.build.volume.note: single nozzle; both nozzles 300 x 320 x 320
h2d-pro.multimaterial: two nozzles (dual-nozzle build volume listed); AMS options not read
h2d-pro.note: Tungsten-carbide nozzle. Read by a targeted extract of the spec page; nozzle size options were not captured, and the 0.4 default is assumed from the lineup.

h2c.name: H2C
h2c.build.volume.note: left single; right single 305 x 320 x 325; dual 300 x 320 x 320; total 330 x 320 x 320
h2c.multimaterial: one fixed left hotend plus six induction hotends on the right (seven); mixed nozzle diameters in one print not supported
h2c.note: Bed 120 C, nozzle 350 C and 65 C chamber read on the spec page; build volumes and nozzle sizes from the buying guide (https://bambulab.com/en/support/buying-guide) and search excerpts.

h3c.name: H3C
h3c.chamber: enclosed, actively heated, HEPA and carbon filter
h3c.multimaterial: nine-tool changer; AMS 3H plus external AMS units, up to 24 colors; mixed nozzle diameters supported
